**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy turning complex technical data into insights that drive better products and smarter decisions? Are you passionate about combining data science with engineering and domain expertise to solve real-world challenges? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Lead Engineer, Data Science, you’ll play a key role in transforming product, sensor and operational data into meaningful insights that support innovation, energy efficiency and data-driven decision-making across Danfoss Climate Solutions.

Working closely with business teams, engineers and data platform specialists, you’ll combine strong analytical capabilities with engineering and domain knowledge to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI and analytics use cases and help build a robust, AI-ready data foundation for future intelligent solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Translate complex business and engineering challenges into analytical questions, data-driven models and actionable insights

• Analyze product, sensor, device and operational data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for performance and energy optimization

• Apply engineering and domain knowledge to shape high-value data science and AI use cases, including feature definition, hypothesis development and validation strategies

• Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to improve data quality, accessibility and usability across analytics and data products

• Contribute to semantic models and knowledge graph capabilities that capture relationships between sensors, devices, assets and their operational context

• Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders, helping turn analytical findings into practical business actions

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong foundation in thermodynamics and physics, with the ability to apply first-principles reasoning to heating and cooling systems and processes

• Experience in data science, applied analytics or similar roles within a technical, industrial or engineering environment

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Python and SQL and the ability to translate engineering insight into data-driven models

• Good understanding of modern data and ML environments, including cloud platforms and the machine learning lifecycle

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data and business teams

• Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, heating/cooling, energy systems or industrial operational data is considered a strong advantage

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Are you passionate about designing cloud solutions that make a real difference?

Do you enjoy turning complex business challenges into innovative, scalable and commercially viable cloud solutions?

Are you motivated by working with customers, shaping technical strategies and collaborating with experts across an international organisation?

If so, we would love to hear from you!

At T-Systems, we help organisations navigate their digital transformation journeys through secure, innovative and future-ready cloud solutions. Our Portfolio Area Cloud plays a key role in driving this transformation, delivering solutions that create real business value for our customers.

We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect/Designer to join our team in Copenhagen and help shape the next generation of cloud solutions for our national and international customers.

In this role you will play a key role in bridging customer needs, cloud technology and business value.

Working closely with our sales teams, architects, delivery specialists and portfolio experts, you will take ownership of designing end-to-end cloud solutions that are technically robust, commercially competitive and ready for successful delivery.

You will be a trusted technical partner throughout the customer engagement, helping translate complex requirements into practical, future-proof solutions.

What you'll be doing

• Design impactful cloud solutions: Develop end-to-end architectures across private, public, hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including cloud migration, modernisation, security and integration.

• Turn customer needs into solutions: Understand business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable, secure and commercially viable cloud designs.

• Shape winning proposals: Partner with sales and bid teams to develop compelling technical solutions, contribute to customer presentations and support complex IT outsourcing opportunities.

• Balance innovation and commercial value: Evaluate solution options, costs, risks and delivery requirements to achieve the right balance between performance, feasibility and business value.

• Collaborate across borders: Work with international teams, delivery units, security specialists and portfolio experts to ensure seamless solution development and handover.

• Stay ahead of the market: Bring industry knowledge, cloud expertise and an understanding of emerging technologies to help strengthen our solutions and competitive positioning.

• Drive continuous improvement: Contribute to architecture standards, solution frameworks and best practices across our Cloud Portfolio.

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with commercial awareness, a collaborative mindset and a genuine passion for solving customer challenges.

Ideally, you will bring:

• Proven experience in cloud solution design, solution architecture or technical presales, preferably within IT services, managed services or IT outsourcing.

• Great knowledge of private, public and hybrid cloud environments, cloud infrastructure and enterprise IT architectures.

• Experience designing complex end-to-end IT solutions and contributing to technical proposals or large-scale customer engagements.

• The ability to balance technical requirements, commercial considerations, delivery capabilities and customer expectations.

• Great analytical and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional and international teams.

• A proactive, structured and customer-focused approach, with the ability to take ownership and work independently.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

You should also be comfortable working in an international environment and travelling occasionally when required.

Why join T-Systems?

At T-Systems, you will have the opportunity to work on complex and meaningful cloud transformation projects, collaborate with experienced specialists across our international organisation and help shape solutions for leading customers.

You will be part of a business where technical expertise, collaboration and fresh thinking are valued, and where your ideas can contribute to how we develop our cloud services.

We believe that our culture is shaped by the everyday actions of our people. Each of us has the opportunity to make a positive impact on our colleagues, our customers and our business.

Because at T-Systems, our people make the difference. #peoplemakethedifference

If you are excited about combining cloud technology, customer engagement and solution innovation, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
**Job Description

****Join us in building a new strategic integration capability

**Are you motivated by shaping new solutions from the ground up? Do you enjoy turning complex business ambitions into secure, scalable technology?

We are establishing a new team in the Customer & Sector Integration tribe to accelerate ERP-to-Bank. The initiative will enable corporate customers to securely share ERP data with Danske Bank, creating opportunities for automated financial processes, improved customer experiences and data-driven products and advisory. You will help determine how Danske Bank connects directly with ERP platforms and through ERP data aggregators, and how ERP data can be securely acquired, governed and made available to internal consumers.

As Solution Architect and IT Solution Owner, you will set the technical direction and lead the architecture of this new solution area. You will work closely with the Product Owner, engineers, internal stakeholders and external ERP ecosystem partners.

**You will

**

• Define and drive the solution architecture for ERP-to-Bank.

• Act as IT Solution Owner for the solutions established within the domain.

• Translate business needs into secure, scalable and maintainable designs.

• Shape integrations with ERP platforms and ERP data aggregators.

• Establish architectural principles, solution boundaries and technical roadmaps.

• Guide decisions related to APIs, data, security, identity and cloud technologies.

• Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory requirements and technology standards.

• Coordinate dependencies across business areas, tribes and external partners.

• Support engineers through technical guidance, sparring and architecture reviews.

The combined role brings responsibility for both technical direction and the lifecycle, governance and operational health of the solutions.

**About You

**

• At least five years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture or technical leadership.

• Current experience as a solution architect, technical lead or IT Solution Owner.

• Strong experience designing integration-heavy, business-critical solutions.

• Knowledge of API-based, event-driven and cloud-native architectures.

• Experience designing secure integrations with customers or external partners.

• The ability to communicate complex technical topics to both technical and business stakeholders.

• A collaborative and pragmatic approach to architecture and delivery.

Experience with banking, ERP platforms, accounting data, payments, cash management or third-party data providers would be an advantage.

**Why join?

**You will join a new team and help define the architecture, integration model and technology choices from the beginning. It is an opportunity to work at the intersection of banking, ERP ecosystems, data and modern integration technology, while turning a strategic ambition into a sustainable production capability.

The workplace can be in Lithuania or Denmark. If you are hired in Lithuania, the monthly salary range: from 5760 EUR to 8640 EUR gross (based on competencies relevant to the role).

Your title in job contract will be Software Architecture.

**Interested?

**Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please include a short motivational letter with your CV. If you have questions about the position, contact Tribe Architect Kenneth Mejnert on mejn@danskebank.dk

ENABL A/S is a specialized engineering company the wind industry delivering Advanced Equipment Solutions and Engineering Services within wind turbine development, production, transportation, installation, and service. ENABL is a trusted partner to Developers, OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers worldwide.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**Beyond That, You'll Bring

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

_Do you want to shape how the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy uses AI to deploy capital? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Product Manager to join our Digital & AI team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

_**Team

**As Product Manager, you will join the Digital & AI team in CIP Fund Solutions, reporting to the Investment Lifecycle Lead. You will be part of a new delivery unit, developing and rolling out digital and AI solutions that will bring efficiency to CIP’s investment teams.

**Role

**Behind every investment decision at CIP sit data rooms, contracts, financial models and investment committee materials. As Product Manager, you will find where AI saves the investment teams the most time or improves their decisions and turn that into products they use every day. You will own the AI product roadmap for the investment lifecycle, from identifying use cases through delivery, adoption and measured impact.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**

• Embed with investment teams to map workflows and quantify where AI adds value.

• Own and prioritize the AI product roadmap for the investment lifecycle.

• Turn business problems into requirements, success metrics and acceptance criteria for engineering.

• Prototype and demo concepts with users before committing engineering capacity.

• Drive adoption and report impact in time saved, cycle time and usage.

• Assess external AI vendors against internal build options, and make sure solutions meet CIP’s security, data protection and responsible AI requirements.

**You

**You have a master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Economics or a related field, and bring 5-8 years of experience in product management, management consulting, technology delivery or an investment role.

You have a track record of taking data or AI products from problem definition to adoption by business users, and working knowledge of LLMs, AI agents and retrieval-based solutions. You are technically fluent (basic Python or SQL, APIs, AI prototyping tools) and can build demos and work credibly with engineers. Experience from infrastructure, private equity, project finance or energy is considered beneficial.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Solid stakeholder management and the credibility to challenge senior investment professionals.

• Clear, concise communication, with the ability to explain complex topics simply.

• Structured and commercially minded, with a focus on where AI creates the most value.

• Ownership of ambiguous problems and the drive to see solutions through to adoption.

• Highly proficient written and verbal English. Danish is not a requirement.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

**CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

**CIP Fund Solutions

**CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

As part of our strategy, centralizing commercials and our work in the partner environment is essential to ensure best in class solutions, and a key factor is our collaboration across the organization. You will play the key role in this.

About the job

Are you someone who takes ownership, creates momentum and enjoys turning ideas into action?

We are looking for a Partner Manager to join our Bid Excellence area. What matters to us is your ability to drive, collaborate and execute on our partner strategy.

You will work closely with the leadership of Bid Excellence and collaborate with senior stakeholders across KMD. This is a role for someone who enjoys taking initiative, navigating different stakeholders and contribute with positive energy and a pragmatic approach.

What you will be doing

As our new Partner Manager, you will be part of Bid Excellence and work closely with the leadership team.

Your role will require you to take ownership of assignments, move activities forward and work collaboratively across the organization. You will have a close collaboration with your manager, who will be your main point of reference, while your work may also involve supporting and interacting with senior stakeholders across KMD.

The role offers an opportunity to develop your experience in a highly collaborative environment where initiative, curiosity and execution matter.

Responsibilities

You will:

• Take ownership of driving the execution of partnerships

• Establish a clear framework for go-to-market collaboration, ensuring that agreements and decisions are translated into action.

• Act as the central interface between internal and external stakeholders

• Strengthen relationships, activate connections across the organization, and connect opportunities with the relevant decision-makers, capabilities, and solutions.

• Establish a clear cadence for tracking progress, priorities, risks, and decision requirements, while ensuring the right information is available and the relevant stakeholders are involved at the right time.

• Identify tangible growth opportunities through customer, partner, and market insights, and use these insights to drive the development and execution of KMD's international strategy.

You are

We imagine that you are someone who enjoys making things happen and collaborating across different areas.

You:

• Have a proactive and hands-on approach.

• Take ownership and follow things through.

• Enjoy collaborating with others.

• Are comfortable working with different stakeholders.

• Can communicate confidently with senior stakeholders.

• Bring positive energy to the people around you.

• Are pragmatic and focused on finding solutions.

• Can work independently while knowing when to involve others.

Most importantly, you have a “get things done” mindset and enjoy working in an environment where collaboration matters.

Life at KMD

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. Our solutions form part of the digital foundation of important institutions, ranging from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies.

Our workplace reflects our values, and we work to create a welcoming and inclusive environment where everyone can be themselves. Well-being and autonomy are important to us, and we want our employees to have the opportunity to shape their own professional journey.

Pandektes is building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world. Behind it is a backend that has to ingest, structure and search a huge database of legal information.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us making sure that the legislation and volume of data stays stable so we can scale our services so we can ingest larger volumes of data, more efficiently.

We have recently closed our Series A round and joining now means you will have a big impact how we grow in the future. This role is based in our Copenhagen HQ.

About Pandektes

Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

The experience you’ll bring

You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

Knowing when it’s good enough

We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

Knowing when to slow down

Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

Make time to experiment

We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

What we offer

You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Legal professionals should be able to stand behind every answer. We build the foundation for that: verified legal data, complete across time and traceable to its source, with research tools built for confident legal judgment. Our vision is clear: to be the leading platform for legal information retrieval, enabling in-depth and accurate legal knowledge in a fast, efficient and user-friendly way using artificial intelligence.

**Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

**Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want significant technical ownership while continuing to build software hands-on.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and help us improve how we develop software – including how we use agentic AI to make capable developers more effective.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work in a product team with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks by making good technical decisions, improving our architecture and development practices, and sharing knowledge with others.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing scalable, maintainable solutions and contributing to architectural decisions

• Improving our codebase, tooling, developer workflows, and technical quality

• Driving or contributing to initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure, architecture, or developer tooling

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or how we build them

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**Developing software with agentic AI

**We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

We are looking for developers who already use agentic AI as part of their development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Strong engineering fundamentals remain essential. AI can increase what a capable developer can achieve, but you remain responsible for the architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality of the software you build.

At Dalux, you will help us take these ways of working further by experimenting, sharing what works, and helping establish effective practices for agentic software development.

**Technologies we work with

**Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS. Our primary technologies include:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• GitHub Copilot

• MSSQL

• Elasticsearch

• AWS

• Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**Your background

**We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field

• Have strong software engineering fundamentals

• Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions

• Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality

• Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers

• Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, or cloud development is useful, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart. As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership and real influence on technical solutions

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve engineering practices beyond your immediate product work

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI for software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

At a big company, the platform layer is a hundred engineers, and you own a slice of it. A driver. A subsystem. A corner of the release pipeline. You go deep, but you rarely get to hold the whole thing. With us you will. One team owns the entire layer: the operating system and firmware on every Airtame, the streaming stack underneath it, the releases that reach devices in the field, and the work of turning new hardware into a shipping product.

The role is roughly 60% hands-on the hardest problems and 40% growing the engineers who work on them.

**About Airtame

**We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and you'd work from there or remotely from within the EU. We make the hardware and the software that runs on it, so a change you make to the firmware ships to every Airtame in the field. The team is cross-functional and spread across Europe, and it reaches a global market from a small base.

Year one outcomes

Take AirPlay and Miracast from beta to default. They're in beta today. A year from now they should be solid enough to ship on by default across the Airtame product line, so customers get them without opting in and never have to think about which protocol they're using. Judge it by connection success rates on the fleet, and by how many customers rely on them day to day.

Make firmware releases boring. The best release is the one nobody has to think about: a predictable cadence, an automated quality bar, and shipping to the whole fleet as routine. A year from now, cutting a release should be a low-drama process the team trusts, and that should let you ship improvements more often. Judge it by release frequency, and by the confidence behind each one.

Turn the next board into a shipping Airtame. New silicon has to boot, hold a network, manage its heat, and run conferencing well enough to sell. By year-end there's a repeatable path from a board landing on a desk to a build QA can test, and you own it. Judge it by how long that path takes, and whether the thermal and acoustic targets hold.

Lead the team. You'll run the 1:1s, set the technical bar, and support team members' growth. The measure is simple: a year in, the team runs on your leadership day to day.

Push AI-assisted development further. The team already builds with AI daily. You'll lead the next step: sharper workflows, better tooling choices, new patterns that make the whole group faster. By year-end, the team's AI practices should be visibly ahead of where they started.

Who you are

• The player-coach. You've set a team's technical direction: the architecture calls, the reviews where the hard problems get caught. And you want the people side too. Growing engineers, running 1:1s, hiring. You're not looking to trade one for the other. Maybe you've been a staff engineer or tech lead ready to own a team, or a manager who never stopped writing code. Either way, 60/40 sounds about right to you.

• At home where software meets hardware. Embedded Linux is your familiar ground: the kernel, the BSP, userspace, C and C++ running on the device itself. You've spent time close to the metal: wireless stacks, streaming protocols, drivers. You can reason about a bug whether it lives in the firmware, the network, or the silicon.

• You ship to hardware you can't reach. When it's firmware on a device mounted in someone's meeting room, a bad release doesn't just roll back with a hotfix. You've owned software that ships to the field, so staged rollouts, over-the-air updates, and testing on the devices themselves come naturally. "Works on my bench" isn't the finish line for you.

• You've turned new hardware into a product. Bare silicon arrives, and someone has to make it boot, talk to the network, manage its heat, and eventually stream. You've done that kind of bringup, or worked close enough to it to lead the people who do.

• You use AI as a daily tool. You write code with it, debug with it, prototype with it. You've formed your own view on where it speeds things up and where it gets in the way, and you help the people around you do the same.

**Logistics

**Location: Remote in Europe, or hybrid from our Copenhagen office.

Employment type: Full-time preferred. We're also open to a project-based contract scoped to delivering the native protocol implementations.

****Why Airtame:

• A shift worth architecting. Airtame's software is moving onto a widening range of devices, including hardware from partners. Leading Platform now means designing for that spread, a bigger and more open problem than keeping one hardware line running.

• A span you can hold. From the bootloader to the release that reaches the field, the whole layer is one person's to shape here, at a size where you can still keep it in your head.

• A healthy work-life balance.

• Significant responsibility and ownership over projects and your field of expertise.

• Five weeks paid vacation and 5 days of extra paid AirtameFlex days.

• Flexible work environment, with a hybrid mindset.

• Pension and private health insurance (on FTE Copenhagen contract).

Airtame is an equal opportunity employer. We have colleagues across the globe, with both in-office and full-time remote workers. This feeds into our international hybrid mindset, with people from 25+ nationalities that make up the Airtame team.

Our work-life cultural balance is key to our success. Our team encompasses our values of trust and open communication to support each other and to collaborate in a fun and collective way.

****What Our Employment Decisions Are NOT Based On

****Race, colour, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, family or parental status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. And we will not tolerate discrimination or harassment.

jobs.description:
Most companies that do conferencing hand you one slice of it. The desktop app, or the media pipeline, or, maybe, the join flow. Everything else you pass over a wall to another team. Not in this case. One team owns the whole path across the Airtame platform: Airtame 3, Airtame Go, Virtual Airtame, and browser, desktop, and mobile apps that go with them. The bar remains at an effortless experience. Someone walks into a room, and starts sharing. No app to hunt for, no login to chase.

The team is four engineers, and we're hiring their technical and people lead: someone who spends about 60% of time hands-on with the hardest problems, and the rest growing the engineers around them.

Judge it by how often it works on the first try, and how rarely it reaches support.

Make it behave the same everywhere. The experience varies between Airtame 3, Virtual Airtame, browser, desktop, and mobile today. Half this job is getting software to play nicely with platforms you don't own: Teams, Zoom, Meet, Webex, the operating system's own media APIs, each with its own idea of how things should go. You've done that kind of integration, and you keep your head when every platform behaves differently.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of Ambu's global operations processes and business functions through major **ERP, QMS, and PLM transformation?

**We are seeking a visionary leader to drive a landmark multi-year digital transformation across our global footprint, optimising production, quality, procurement, and supply chain processes.

Currently in the initial scoping phase, this initiative will consolidate enterprise operations globally using the Infor M3 ERP platform and the Dassault Systèmes ecosystem.

This high-impact role will drive the guiding principles for our future ERP, QMS, and PLM operating model. The position requires a leader who can drive a complex program incl. effective change management, simplify complex workflows, deliver business transformation, eliminate fragmented Excel-dependent processes, and ensure global standardization within an ambitious 3–4-year timeline.

Reporting to the CFO, you will set the pace, resolve cross-functional roadblocks, and hold the program, external system integrators, and business stakeholders accountable.

Core Responsibilities Governance & Strategy

Drive the future-state global process, business transformation roadmap, and operating model, balancing multi-entity standardisation with critical local requirements. Define and drive the ERP implementation roadmap to maximise business improvements, value realisation, consistency, and cost efficiency.

Lead a large global program team consisting of e.g. Global Process Owners, Global business owners, Technical Workstream Lead etc. in a mix of direct and dotted reporting lines, while operating in a matrix organisation across six VP-led functional areas.

Manage the external vendor relationships with the vendors selected to support the program

Process Optimisation & Innovation

Drive and be responsible for implementing the program, harmonising processes across Finance, production, quality, procurement, and supply chain functions, and translating this into measurable business improvements. Lead digitalisation initiatives, including AI-driven methods and process intelligence solutions, in collaboration with business stakeholders and external system integrator consultants.

Business Transformation

Lead the development of a dedicated team of process managers, business managers, and subject matter experts. Execute a global change management strategy tailored to a fast-paced, compliance-driven culture, ensuring alignment across regions and driving business improvements and value realisation throughout.

Compliance & Data Harmonization

Partner with Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs to ensure that platforms meet international compliance requirements. Lead migration, cleansing, and structuring of legacy data into a unified and scalable architecture.

**Required Experience & Technical Skills Executive Track Record

**15+ years of leadership experience managing large global transformation projects, digital transformation programs, or enterprise application implementations. Ideally a background incl. commercial, financial or operational leadership roles.

Transformational Delivery

Proven experience leading end-to-end ERP, PLM, or QMS implementations and business process transformation within multinational organizations. Experience with Infor M3 and Dassault Systèmes is highly advantageous.

Industry Context

Strong background in manufacturing, quality, and supply chain operations within highly regulated industries (e.g., medical devices, life sciences, or pharmaceuticals).

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.

Soft Skills & Leadership Qualities Executive Presence

Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge operational requirements and technology solutions while influencing senior leadership.

Resilience & Adaptability

Thrives in complex and demanding environments, demonstrating strong cultural awareness and the ability to resolve alignment challenges with diplomacy and determination.

Global Mobility

Flexibility to travel internationally and spend extended periods at manufacturing sites during critical project phases. Expected travel commitment of approximately 50–80 days per year, including visits to Malaysia, China, Mexico, and the United States.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

With an IoT platform connecting more than 6 million units — and growing — Trackunit is building the platform that will enable the construction industry to work faster, smarter, and more securely. And we need you to help run and scale it.

As an SRE, you will join our Europe-based team and be part of a global SRE organization spanning Europe and Canada. This is a hands-on role focused on the daily operation and continuous improvement of our platform, with room to grow into larger design and architecture work as you build depth.

The platform owned by SRE consists of an AWS cloud, Kubernetes clusters (EKS), and our IaC setup running Terraform and Terramate, as well as a GitOps delivery platform built on Argo CD and Atlantis.

We support engineering teams with 150+ developers. You will help keep a platform used by 15,000+ active users every day secure, available, and easy to build on.

We're looking for someone curious and collaborative — happy to share knowledge and ask questions as well.

Experience level: roughly 2–5 years in an SRE, DevOps, platform, or infrastructure operations role. If you're further along and the day-to-day scope appeals to you, apply anyway — we'll have the conversation.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

**What's in it for you?

**

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

**What You'll Do

**Your week will be a mix of keeping things running well and making them better.

• Operate and improve the platform. Monitoring, alerting, capacity, cost, and the steady stream of small improvements that keep a large AWS and Kubernetes estate healthy.

• Work in code, not consoles. Infrastructure changes go through Terraform and Helm, reviewed as pull requests and delivered through Atlantis and Argo CD.

• Keep the platform secure. Patching, vulnerability remediation, base image updates, and closing findings — a recurring, meaningful part of the job rather than a side task.

• Take part in incident response. You'll join our on-call rotation (SRE team, business hours) and contribute to incidents and follow-up work.

• Handle triage and requests from developer teams. Understanding what they need, unblocking them, and spotting when a repeated request could be automated.

**Who You Are

**We think you'll need

• Hands-on experience running workloads on AWS.

• Basic knowledge with Kubernetes.

• Basic knowledge about infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.

• Comfortable with Git, Linux and Windows.

• Clear written communication — a lot of our work happens in tickets, PRs, and docs.

**Nice to have, not expected

**

• EKS specifically, or tooling like Karpenter, Argo CD, Atlantis, or Terramate.

• Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sumo Logic, or similar).

• Scripting in Python or Go.

• Security or compliance work — vulnerability management, CIS benchmarks, certification programmes.

• Multi-region or multi-account AWS architecture.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You’re curious and self-driven, while also knowing when to ask for help when needed.

• You finish things. Small, well-tested changes shipped consistently beat big ideas that stall.

• You care about the developers and customers using the platform, not just the platform itself.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement. An interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work — including MCP servers and agents against our own platform — and we expect that to grow. We don’t expect you to have experience with this—but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries — this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

**How You'll Grow Here

**We hire at this level expecting you to move beyond it, and we've structured the team so that happens on purpose rather than by accident.

• A rotation model that protects your focus. The team splits between operational duty and project work, so you're not permanently interrupt-driven. You get real blocks of time to go deep on something.

• Mentorship that's built in. Senior colleagues review your PRs and pair with you on incidents. Asking questions is the expected behaviour, not a sign you're struggling.

• Exposure to the big architecture work. You'll start with scoped pieces and take on more as you build context.

• A clear conversation about your development. Regular 1:1s that cover where you want to be, not just what you shipped last sprint.

**What We're Building Next

**Trackunit is moving from a SaaS company to a platform built on telemetry data from the construction industry worldwide. For SRE, that means going beyond delivering infrastructure to building the capabilities that let our developers and customers spin up environments tailored to their needs in the regions they need them.

Things on our roadmap include:

• Expanding the platform into a true multi-region architecture.

• Building self-service platform capabilities so developer teams move at their own pace.

• Making better use of AI in our own operations, through MCP servers and agents.

You won't be expected to lead these on day one. You will be in the room, and there will be pieces with your name on them.

**What Happens From Here — Recruitment Process Overview

**

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with a member of our Talent Partner team

• Personality-based interview. You will be asked to complete an online personality assessment prior to the interview. There are no correct answers and we are not trying to categorise you — the aim is a dialogue about the results and Trackunit's culture, so you get to know us better as well.

• Assignment-specific interview. You will be given a case to prepare after the initial screening interview. You will present the case to relevant colleagues across Trackunit, who you will also work closely with in the role.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with Engineering Manager, Kåre Brandborg and an SRE team member.

• References and background checks (if needed). If required, we will obtain references from former employers and perform level-specific background checks, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're lucky to have you!

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction — one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.occupation: Experienced Senior Lean Consultant for Project Excellence at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by driving lean transformation at a company level and you thrive on turning complex challenges into tangible business impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Lean Consultant to join our team of highly skilled colleagues in the Project Excellence department. In Project Excellence, we act as internal consultants grounded in Lean, supporting projects and leadership across NNE by strengthening performance management, structured problem solving and continuous improvement practices.

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you will work closely with project organisations and leaders to set direction for improvement initiatives, build Lean capabilities and drive performance. At the same time, you will take an active, hands-on role in facilitating problem solving and implementing improvements on our most critical projects, ensuring that ideas translate into real impact.

This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of leadership, Lean transformation and project execution, contributing to building a strong and sustainable performance and improvement culture across NNE.

You’ll be based in our Virum Office, but the role requires you to visit our project sites in Kalundborg and around the Copenhagen area on a regular basis.

How you might spend your days

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you’ll be:

• Helping the Project Excellence department set direction for continuous improvement and Lean in NNE, aligned with NNE’s strategy

• Building Lean capabilities by developing and embedding structured problem solving, lean project management and continuous improvement practices

• Designing and delivering training in Lean tools, Lean principles and Lean ways of working across NNE

• Coaching leaders and teams to strengthen performance management and Lean leadership behaviours

• Facilitating and driving structured problem-solving on major projects, using A3 thinking as our core approach

• Advising on consistent implementation of improvements, ensuring solutions are anchored and deliver real impact

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Passionate about Lean thinking and driven to create real lasting business impact

• Confident in engaging, challenging and developing leaders and teams at all levels

• Comfortable operating in complex environments, bringing clarity, structure and direction

• Pragmatic and execution-focused with a great drive to turn ideas into results

• A credible role model who takes ownership and leads by example

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Extensive experience driving continuous improvement and lean transformations in complex organisations

• Proven ability to lead and implement change with measurable impact

• Solid experience working closely with senior leaders on performance and improvement agendas

• A relevant academic degree at Master level

• Excellent facilitation, coaching and stakeholder management skills across organisational levels

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please Contact Director Daniel Iwarsson at +45 3075 7823 or Principal Consultant, Mikkel Bonne at +45 3191 8723 between 12.00-15.00 (12 AM-3 PM) on weekdays.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Build the mobile app that construction professionals rely on every day.

**Every day, tens of thousands of construction professionals around the world use the Dalux app to inspect buildings, document progress, navigate BIM models, capture photos, report issues and collaborate directly from active construction sites.

We're looking for Mobile Software Engineers who want to build software that solves real-world problems at scale.

**What You'll Be Building

**You'll join one of our cross-functional product teams responsible for developing and improving the Dalux mobile application.

Together with developers, product managers and designers, you'll help shape new features from the product discussion through implementation, testing and release.

Our app is built using C# and .NET MAUI , allowing us to share the majority of our codebase while integrating with native iOS and Android capabilities whenever it makes sense.

**Some of the challenges you'll work on

**Mobile development at Dalux goes far beyond forms and lists. You'll help solve challenges such as:

• Building reliable workflows for construction sites with limited connectivity

• Integrating with mobile hardware such as 360 cameras and GPS antennas

• Optimizing performance across both Android and iOS devices

• Designing intuitive user experiences for professionals working in demanding environments

• Continuously improving the speed, quality and usability of one of the industry's leading mobile applications

**Our engineering culture

**You'll become part of a product team where engineers have real ownership.

We believe the people building the software should influence how it's built. That means short decision paths, close collaboration with product and design, and plenty of room to propose new ideas.

Our development teams work using agile principles with a strong focus on quality, collaboration and continuous improvement.

**We'd love to hear from you if you

**

• Have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a similar technical field

• Enjoy solving complex engineering problems

• Care about building products that people genuinely enjoy using

• Like collaborating with other developers, designers and product managers

Experience with one or more of the following is a plus:

• C#

• .NET MAUI

• Kotlin

• Swift

• Flutter

• React Native

If you don't have professional mobile experience yet but are passionate about mobile development and have a strong software engineering foundation, we'd still encourage you to apply.

**Why Dalux?

**At Dalux, you'll build software that makes one of the world's largest industries more digital, efficient and sustainable.

Our products are used in more than 140 countries, and mobile is central to that experience.

All software development happens from our headquarters in Copenhagen, where you'll work alongside a growing community of software engineers in an environment that values knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning. We also have monthly social events and various clubs for those who want to take part.

You'll find a flat organization with a high degree of trust, opportunities to influence the product, and colleagues who care deeply about building great software.

**Ready to join us?

**If you'd like to help build the mobile platform used by tens of thousands of construction professionals every day, we'd love to hear from you.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. We develop digital tools that help make the construction industry smarter and more efficient through intuitive software and Building Information Modelling (BIM). Today, our solutions are used on construction projects in more than 140 countries worldwide.

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

**About us:

**Founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014, Templafy’s success is built by our 60+ employee nationalities found at offices around the world. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and empowered, they perform at their best—creating a win for all. Our unique product and dedication to innovation and excellence have raised over $200 million in funding from top investors like Insight Venture Partners, Seed Capital, Dawn Capital, Damgaard Company and Golub Capital.

**Role Overview

**The Sales Executive, EMEA is responsible for developing new enterprise relationships and helping customers realise meaningful value from Templafy’s Agentic Solutions.

Based in our Copenhagen office, you will work with large organisations across EMEA to understand how they create business-critical documents and identify opportunities to make those processes faster, more accurate and easier to govern.

You will lead complex enterprise sales processes from initial outreach, engagement through to commercial agreement, working closely with customers and Templafy specialists to build a clear business case and demonstrate how Templafy can support document workflows, brand governance and enterprise AI adoption.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Build and develop a high-quality pipeline of new enterprise opportunities across EMEA.

• Run new-business sales cycles from initial outreach, engagement and discovery through to negotiation and close.

• Understand customers’ business priorities and identify opportunities to accelerate important document workflows, improve consistency and reduce unnecessary manual effort.

• Help customers quantify the value of improving how documents are created, governed and maintained across their organisation.

• Develop compelling business cases that connect Templafy’s capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.

• Engage senior business and technology stakeholders on the opportunities and challenges created by AI, including adoption, governance, scalability and reliable enterprise outcomes.

• Work closely with pre-Sales and other specialists to bring relevant customer use cases to life and demonstrate value using real-world workflows.

• Build strong, trusted relationships across complex stakeholder groups and maintain disciplined pipeline management, qualification and forecasting.

**Experience

**

• 5+ years of enterprise SaaS or software sales experience, with a strong focus on new business.

• A track record of achieving sales targets and winning complex, enterprise opportunities.

• Experience building pipeline as well as developing opportunities generated through Marketing, partners and other channels.

• Experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders within large organisations.

• Strong experience in consultative, value-based enterprise selling.
